analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 악화 지속
analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 하락 마감, 일봉 RSI 36.7로 과매도 구간 진입. MACD 히스토그램은 -60.8130으로 개선되었으나 여전히 음수 구간. 주봉 ADX 26.1로 뚜렷한 추세는 유지되나, -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 우세. ATR 2,100원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(2,730원) 설정 시 진입가 25,200원 기준 손절 22,470원, 목표가 29,000원 설정 가능. 그러나 추세 전환 신호 미확인으로 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: The ETF closed lower for three consecutive sessions. The daily RSI is at 36.7, entering oversold territory. While the MACD histogram improved to -60.8130, it remains negative. The weekly ADX is 26.1, indicating a clear trend, but the -DI is above the +DI, suggesting downward pressure. With an ATR of 2,100 KRW, a stop loss of 1.3x ATR (2,730 KRW) from an entry of 25,200 KRW would be 22,470 KRW, with a target of 29,000 KRW. However, without a confirmed trend reversal signal, a wait-and-see approach is warranted.

· Current price (25,200 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (26,987 KRW / 28,568 KRW / 33,052 KRW): Confirmed below short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (35,567 KRW / 36,497 KRW): In a weak long-term trend zone.
· 52-week position (21.2%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (32.7→36.7) + Attempting to exit oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-392.1988→-60.8130) + Improving but still a bearish signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 24,162 KRW) + Bandwidth of 30.84% indicating expanded volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line (25,055 KRW) + Close to the 5-day low.
· Swing resistance line (30,570 KRW) + Potential for trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High followed by sideways) + Bearish reversal signal.

analysis.patternNoteEn: Entered a sideways consolidation phase after forming a Lower High, awaiting trend reversal signals.

MACD histogram shows improvement, but bearish trend reversal signal is weak.
Weekly ADX at 26.1 maintains trend, but -DI dominance indicates continued downward pressure.

analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독 유지. 금일 RSI 과매도 구간 진입 및 MACD 히스토그램 개선으로 매수 점수 소폭 상승했으나, 여전히 하락 추세 및 -DI 우위로 인해 관망 유지.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Today's RSI entering oversold and MACD histogram improvement slightly increased the buy score, but the downtrend and -DI dominance warrant maintaining the wait-and-see stance.
